identification: Glazed ceramic (stoneware/earthenware) elephant garden stool, cobalt blue body with white slip-moulded caparison, tassels and headdress, square seat on top with shou (longevity) roundel, shou medallions on the saddle cloth sides, chrysanthemum on the plinth, key-fret border. Chinese/Vietnamese export decor of the type made in large numbers c1980-2010, 43 cm high. Not antique, not porcelain. Estimate 50-80, current bid A$25.
